episodes_data.title: Day-Tripping Down to Naniwa!
episodes_data.description: Pop gets invited to a mascot-idol event in Osaka, and Koichi accompanies her.

episodes_data.title: Crabtastic Rampage!
episodes_data.description: Koichi and Pop get dragged into an incident when a Trigger dealer unleashes a cast of rampaging robotic crabs!

episodes_data.title: Public and Private
episodes_data.description: Tsukauchi`s investigation into the Trigger network has hit a wall, and he turns to All Might for advice.

episodes_data.title: A Rational Man
episodes_data.description: Koichi`s in double trouble, facing down a villain who might clobber him, and Eraser Head who might arrest him!

episodes_data.title: The Man Returns
episodes_data.description: Koichi and Pop get into more Trigger trouble, and we learn where Knuckleduster has been.

episodes_data.title: Rain and Cloud
episodes_data.description: Koichi encounters Eraser Head, who reminiscences about his student days.

episodes_data.title: Glass Sky
episodes_data.description: When he was young, Aizawa`s inexperience and awkward Quirk forced him to grapple with his self-esteem.

episodes_data.title: A Sky with No Rain Left
episodes_data.description: When Aizawa was a younger, he and his friend Shirakumo were forced into a fight with a giant villain...

episodes_data.title: Farewell Party!
episodes_data.description: With his legal problems soon to be taken care of, Captain Celebrity makes plans to return to America.

episodes_data.title: Zero Hour
episodes_data.description: Captain Celebrity`s farewell party begins, but the Scarred Man has some unpleasant surprises in store...

episodes_data.title: Balloon Soul
episodes_data.description: Captain Celebrity tries to save the Sky Egg with Koichi`s help, while reminiscing on what brought him here.

episodes_data.title: This Is a Hero!!
episodes_data.description: The Sky Egg falls as Captain Celebrity hits his limit, with only one person capable of saving the day...

episodes_data.title: Graduation and Career Path
episodes_data.description: Captain Celebrity returns to the United States, and Koichi must decide what to do with his future.
